verses.1: May they not harm David from their own territory. May they keep the house safe, so that it won’t be destroyed.
verses.2: Save me from my enemies, O God! Save me from those who seek to destroy me.
verses.3: Save me from the effects of poison, and from those who are evil. Save me!
verses.4: For behold, evil spirits have surrounded me; they torment me. But I am innocent and without any sins or faults, O LORD.
verses.5: May they be filled with joy and desire to obey my commands. And may they see.
verses.6: And you, Jehovah God and the armies of Israel’s gods, rise up to rule over all nations. Do not allow any of their evil deeds to go unpunished.
verses.7: They will return to the city in the evening, like dogs. They will be scattered throughout the city.
verses.8: Now, they will show their destruction with their lips, because whoever is a liar…
verses.9: And you, LORD, will play a joke on them; you will make them laugh at all nations.
verses.10: May God keep it safe for you, as He did with my life.
verses.11: God of my mercy, please bless me. God, please protect me with your strength.
verses.12: Do not kill them, so that my people may not forget to honor you in your army. Let them be spared from being destroyed by Adonai.
verses.13: Their sins will be exposed, and they will be captured in their arrogance. They will be punished for their actions.
verses.14: All of them are in chaos; they do not know that God has appointed Jacob as the ruler over the land.
verses.15: And they will return to the evening, like dogs. They will be scattered everywhere.
verses.16: They will be motivated to eat, if they don’t get tired and continue to work.
verses.17: And I will bless you and praise you in the morning, for you have been merciful to me on that day of my distress.
verses.18: O God, we say to You: May You be the God of kindness and mercy.
